newsitem.title: INDIA: Boat capsizes in India, 54 believed drowned.
newsitem.headline: Boat capsizes in India, 54 believed drowned.

text.p: At least 54 people were believed drowned in India on Friday after a boat capsized in the eastern state of Bihar, the United News of India (UNI) reported.
The news agency said the overloaded boat with 60 passengers capsized in the Bagmati river. Six people swam ashore and the remaining passengers were still missing, it said.
Police in Khagaria, where the incident occurred about 180 km (112 miles) east of the state capital Patna, told Reuters they could not confirm the number of dead.
